All prices in ZAR, billed once a year in advance through Paystack, and exclude VAT. Verification is re-run every 12 months on renewal.

Common questions

Why must every listing show the badge?

The badge is how Getclient grows and how your visitors check you are real. Every application has to show the Listed on Getclient badge on its website before it can be approved, on every tier.

Can I buy a badge without the check?

No. The tier is set by our reviewers after the checks pass, and the applicant cannot set it themselves. Paying for Blue or Gold buys the verification work and the promotion, not the badge on its own.

What exactly does Gold advertising include?

Gold businesses appear in the sponsored bar at the top of every page, in the featured Gold section at the bottom of every page, first in every list, beside other businesses’ profiles and above search results. Every placement is labelled Ad.

What does Blue promotion include?

Blue Verified businesses appear in the Blue Verified showcase on every page, directly under the Gold section, and rank above every Basic listing.

What happens if I do not renew?

Your listing drops to Basic and stays in the directory with your description and contact details. The badge on your website switches to Listed on Getclient within 24 hours.

Do you take a commission on jobs?

No. Getclient charges a flat annual fee. What you agree with a client is between you and them.
